balls.text: Another good catch to finish, Starc finishes with five. Faf moves to the right and dives, takes it with both hands while in the air. Was a fullish ball to which Mulder made room and tried to drive with an open bat-face
Length around fourth, defended through point

Another stunner, this time it's Axar taking a slider. Was diving low to the left at mid-off, had his eyes on the ball and the hands followed creating kind of a diamond shape. Went with both hands and slid through while staying in possession. Harshal had danced down to get the ball on a full length and went for the extra cover drive.
Shortish ball just outside off is pulled across to deep midwicket. Checked shot but firm
Fullish on fourth, jabbed to point
Length down leg, past the attempted pull it goes.
Rahul calls for the catch, Vipraj dives low to the left and tries to taking it with his left hand. Tips it to long-off. Was a full ball that was driven
Length on fourth, zips off the pitch does the 88ks legbreak. Batter backs away and cuts to deep point
Fullish on leg, 89ks, worked to long-on
Full on off, punched to cover. 87ks

Given caught behind, but very late. KL was convinced, ump stood still, felt for a second like DC will have to review. In the end it's Harshal who does. Was a length ball that was spinning away. Harshal's was tip-toeing and square-on as he tried to punch the ball through midwicket. Got beaten on the outside edge, so won't be caught behind. Hit wide on the knee-roll, but there will be a check for lbw. The legbreak landed a touch short, in line with off and spun away to fourth. Impact's outside off
Length in the channel, cut well but finds point
Mulder waits for the slower short ball, ball rises just under chest height and he checks the pull, gets it in the 45-metre gap between deep square leg and deep midwicket
Three-quarter length on off. 132ks, touch skiddy, Harshal moves across and flicked through midwicket
Shortish slower ball is wide and doesn't rise, Mulder has to wait before cutting to deep point
Full on fourth, driven nicely to the left of Axar at mid-off
Length on fourth, pushed to deep point
Length on middle, 82ks, Harshal moves to off stump and flicks through square leg

JFM times his jump to perfection at deep midwicket, he was racing to the right, both feet off the ground as he caught the ball with both hands and then landed on the right foot before twisting and tumbling to the right. Aniket is on one knee before dragging himself off. Was a teasing ball. On the shorter side, slow too, Aniket swivelled and pulled it hard again, timing was good, it went flat. Just a case of freak catching.
Can't go full, this was a proper half-volley. He cleared the front leg, pumped it through the line over the bowler
Goes back to a fullish length ball that spins in to top of middle, Mulder's back springs up as he flicks it softly through square leg. 82ks
Fullish on leg, defended towards midwicket with a straight bat
Full ball down leg is slog swept to deep backward square leg. Think Aniket wanted to go over short fine, got it too flat and a touch too square
Patted to cover off the back foot to the off side
Mulder tentative on the back foot, square-on too, as the length ball on off rushes him. He checks his block to cover, a touch uppish. Ayyoyo, goes Rahul
Wide on a length, cut to sweeper cover
Aniket is SRHing. Seven-down and he's belting them like they're 200 for 0. This is a touch wide, on a length, flat-batted over the bowler. Axar not aiming for the stumps though
Touch short, just outside off, Aniket swivels and pulls it with remarkable hand speed. Over cow corner
Aniket happy to continue swinging. Gets a wide length ball that he flays with a horizontal bat over cover

And Kuldeep manages to tease out Cummins this time. Inexpensive overs were being strung and the hit-me ball was sent down. Slow on a length, angling away just outside off. Cummins opened his stance and tried to drag it across with a full-power pull. Found JFM close to the deep-midwicket boundary
Fifty for Aniket, cheers from the crowd as he flicks it off the back foot to deep midwicket to get there. Subdued celebration from him, big applause from Kishan and Co
Teasingly lobbed up on middle, a bit of drift in, Cummins tries to wallop it through midwicket. Gets it off the bottom of the bat to deep midwicket. 83ks
Goes deep in the crease to a fullish 80ks ball on fourth, spinning away, and dabs it to backward point
Guides the 80ks length ball on fourth to short third
Spin in from a length after landing on middle, clipped off the back foot to midwicket

Aniket goes outside off to get inside the line, the length ball is slightly down leg and goes back the attempted slog sweep. Aniket wanted to go over short fine leg. Wide not given, SRH review. This will be interesting because the batter was on one knee, on fourth stump. The ump says the ball would've hit the batter had he stayed in place. So, the review is turned down.
Length on fourth, cut to point
Stays in the crease again, this time he flicks the fullish ball on middle through square leg
Length on fourth, gentle cut to point. Played from the crease
Length on top of middle, pulled to deep midwicket
Length on fourth, 94ks, cut to backward point

Tight over finishes with the wicket. 84ks fullish ball outside off, tossed up, Manohar tried to whack it over long-off. Drove it off the bottom of the bat, easy catch for Faf, who took it with a lunge. DC back on top
Turned with a closed bat face through the leg side

Sharp spin inwards to cut him in half. Abhinav had started dancing down but realised that the length was shorter than he expected and planted the back foot in the crease while trying to fend the ball with a straightish bat. Bottom hand came off as the stock ball that landed on a shortish length spun through the gate. Got good bounce too
Length on fourth, defended to point
Length around the stumps, worked off the back foot through midwicket
Length ball around off is defended through where silly mid-off would've been. KL runs after it and throws it slightly wildly, but it goes to long-on and there's no overthrow
Length just outside off, guided through point

Vipraj takes a stunning catch running back, even he can't believe how that stuck. He ran back from backward point, coiled about a touch. He didn't slow down and almost overran the ball, almost being the keyword. His body was facing the crowd, the head was up looking at the ball, he was cramped but managed to catch the ball around chest height before tumbling back. Was a three-quarter-length ball around off that Klaasen tried to mow over long-on. Ball skied off the edge. Klaasen's counterattack ends.
Wide yorker. Marginal call, it's an extra conceded. Klaasen let it go
Mohit goes shorter, Aniket heaves hard again. It's a pull this time, clothed to long-on

Yorker missed, that's boshed over the bowler. Aniket went across to fourth stump again, the feet were scissored and it was like a forced baseball swing. Bat-face turned inwards a touch but ball went well over the bowler

Clattered, Faf gets a hand at cover but that was hit too hard, he jumped to his diagonal right, got right up and flung his right hand up, got fingertips on it. Stopped in the deep. Was a wide ball, Aniket got outside off and pre-meditated a flash. Timed it well.
Length on fourth, driven to long-off. On top of the bounce, flowing follow-through too. Along the ground
Goes back to the legspinner, punches it down to the non-striker. Decent start
Sees him back away and pushes it wide outside off, just inside the tramline. He cannot reach it
Pitched down leg, he goes for the sweep but toe-ends it to the on side around the corner
The wrong'un on a length on middle and leg, pushed to the off side
Pushes it wider outside off, slapped to deep cover
Welcomed with a massive strike! Looked easy to the eye, Klaasen. Tossed up in the slot on off and middle, he takes a forward stride and lofts it into the sight-screen
Dug in on middle, pulled to deep backward square leg
Very full outside off, dug out to wide long-on
Glorious! Full and wide outside off, Verma reaches out by getting down on a knee and launches it over extra cover. No chance for Starc running to his left from long-off
Yorker wide outside off, 132.2kph, he gets across and squeezes an inside edge to the keeper
Slower one, full outside off, chopped in front of point to the off side
Length ball on off, 134.1kph heaved through wide mid-on
Fuller on off, slogs it all along the ground to deep midwicket, 16 off the Axar over
On a length outside off, cut away through point
Clips it away through square leg

Use of feet, stupendous! Axar tosses it up and lands it on a length in line of the stumps. Verma slinks down the track and lofts it straight over with a straight blade. Fifty of the partnership up in quick time
Swiftly goes back and deposits into the deep square leg stands. Not a bad ball by any means. Angling in on a length, he quickly picks up length, goes back and launches it high and long
Flatter outside off, punched to deep cover-point
Fuller and quicker outside off, drilled to deep cover
Spinning away from a length, cut to backward point, who dives and half-stops it
Fetch that! This is high and long, Verma sure making DC pay for the drop. Tossed up on a good length around off, he gets under it and deposits it over long-on
Bammed down the ground! Nicely tossed up outside off, it is in the slot, Verma delays his shot, wrists it straight down the ground to beat du Plessis at long-on

Miles high.... and lands in an empty space. Lucky for Klaasen. He sees the length ball and goes back to heave it over midwicket. But it is the slider and he doesn't connect well, lands well before the running deep midwicket fielder. Uh, oh! Nigam has overstepped
Fuller and wider outside off, punched with the turn to long-off
Legspinner on a length outside off, slapped through cover-point
On a length on off, he goes back to punch it to long-off. SRH 58 for 4 after the powerplay
Fuller on middle and leg, heaved to deep midwicket
Punched down to long-off
Nonchalant punch off the back foot. Shortish outside off, he goes back and hits it wide of short cover

Leading edge and Porel cannot hang on. Lands it on a length on leg, spins away after that. Verma looks to hit it across the line and skies it high. Porel back tracks from cover, circling around, cannot cling on
Flatter length ball on off, punched wide of cover off the back foot
Back of a length down leg, steer-pulled to short fine leg. Another expensive over from Starc, but one that had Head's wicket
Crrrunched through cover! Full length ball slanting away, he takes a step forward and drills it through the off side. It was at 146.4kph
Pulled away in fine style. Short on middle and leg, Klaasen stays still and pulls it low to high over deep square leg
Length ball on middle and leg, defended back to the bowler
Super field placement. length ball angling away, Verma goes back and across to pull but finds Stubbs at deep forward square leg
Length ball angling away from off, steered past short third. He has overstepped here

Starc gets Head for the sixth time across formats in all recognised cricket! It is a nothing shot. Back of a length cross-seam delivery outside off, Head hangs back to steer it over short third. Only manages a glove to Rahul, who makes no mistake. SRH's challenge falling flat and now their line-up will be severely tested. Starc is given a third over inside the powerplay and he delivers with the big scalp

Did Mukesh get a finger to it? and is Head in? Full and outside off, drilled straight back. Mukesh stretches his right hand and gets a finger to it. Is Head fine though? Yep, has his back leg inside the crease in time
Dug short and sliding down leg, 135.8kph, he gets inside the line but misses the swish
Short on leg, gets big on the pull towards square leg
Powered away over cover. Giving width to Head is a crime. Lands in the slot well outside off, 129.2kph, he plants his front foot forward and carves it over the off side
Length ball well wide of the batter, 137.5kph, he leaves it be anticipating a wide but is not given
A mix-up but Verma makes it. Goes back to the length ball, taps iot in front of backward point and runs but is sent back by Head. He dives and Stubbs throws is slightly wide
Length ball on leg, Head heaves it off the inner half to deep square leg. It was the slower one at 117kph
Length ball away from him, defended to backward point

Flicked over forward square leg. Starc spears it full and just outside leg, Verma leans into it and is slightly off-balanced as he flicks it. The bat face turns in his hands but it is enough to take it to the rope
Short ball to start, 142.3kph, he gets inside the line and ducks under it

High in the air and straight into the waiting hands of Axar! SRH collapsing early. The offcutter from Starc, on middle and off. Reddy perhaps expects another high-pace delivery and backs away massively to go over the off side. All he manages to do his sky it high to Axar, who gets to his right from mid-on, settles under it and takes it
Back of a length angling away, he stands tall and defends it to backward point
The late swing did Rahul in. Back of a length down leg, NKR lets it go. Rahul gets to his left to collect that but it sways well away to his right for five wides

Slashed straight to the man in the deep! Starc and Kishan both cannot believe it for contrasting reasons. This is short and wide at 139.8kph, too wide to resist the slash. But Kishan hits it straight to STubbs at deep backward point. Didn't have to move an inch. DC make early inroads
Flicked away in style. Mukesh goes for the yorker but slips in a low full toss on the pad, 137.2kph, easy pickings for Head who just gets it away from short fine leg
Angling away on a length, 136.5kph, he comes forward to steer it to deep backward point

Huge appeal for lbw, did it pitch in line? That is what Axar and Rahul are checking with Mukesh before DC opt for the review. Very full in length, Kishan looks to flick but misses it completely. From the initial angle, looked like it landed outside leg, which is what ball-tracking says. DC lose a review early
Full on middle, heaved off the inner half towards mid-on for a quick one
Length ball, 135.7kph, a hint of swing down leg, easy take for KLR
Back of a length on leg, 136.1kph, Kishan doesn't get the attempted pull off the middle, mistimed through square leg
Dug in short on middle and leg, pulled on the bounce to deep square leg
Full and swinging in on middle, flicked to midwicket

Almost played on! And oh dear, Abhishek is run-out! He did not go for it quickly, almost sent Head back but then continued running. NIgam gets in from backward point and underarms it on the stumps. Head looked to go hard at the cover drive and got a thick inside edge onto his back leg. The ball rolled to the off side and he set off for a run. Little did he anticipate the run-out
Back of a length down leg, he lifts his front leg and whips it past short fine leg. Not enough timing, so JFM gets around in the deep
Timed it straight down the ground! Overpitched on off, Head just times his push to perfection. Before today, he had not hit a single boundary off Starc across formats, today he has two in two
Oh dear. Axar though cover would dive and stop it and doesn't run hard to his right from mid-off. Head off in a typical fashion. Stands still, reaches out and drives it through extra cover
And Abhishek uses his feet straightaway! Charges down to the length ball around middle and hits it on the bounce to Axar at mid-off. A quick run gets SRH going
Finished with a six. Clubbed the slot ball with a closed bat-face with the freest of bat swings.
Pulled with a twirl. It's into the ground and to deep midwicket. Stubbs has gotten the better of his fellow South African

Chipped drive is uppish but in the gap to the right of the infielder at cover, long-off runs to the left but in vain. Was a length ball just outside off, Stubbs took a decent forward stride and hit it with a lunge
Tries to slug the length ball over long-on, misses. It goes through fourth stump

Deep in the crease again, this time Stubbs pulls it through backward square leg. Was actually a good bouncer, around head-height, Stubbs had to jump up and swat the ball into the ground while swivelling
Full on off, flicked to wide long-on
Yorker missed, low full toss is around shin-height and Stubbs drives through the line. It's a chip that's too straight for long-on. Stubbs was standing very deep in the crease too
Pulls the short ball on fourth through deep midwicket
Very short and wide 135ks ball gets tennis-ball bounce, a tennis forehand is the response. Through midwicket the ball goes
Yorker on fourth, 134ks, punched to short cover
Full on middle and off, flicked to long-on
Works the length ball around off to long-on
Porel uses the pace (93ks) and the wide angle to run it fine of short third. Was a fullish length ball, Porel opened the face fully to ruin what was a good spell overall from Zeeshan
Flatter length ball around off, pulled to long-on
Fullish on top of fourth, batter goes back and pulls to long-on

Sliced but clears long-off. Porel danced down, had a low, horizontal swipe while on the move; Zeeshan kept it wide and did him in flight, but the bat swing was free. The ball did go high but cleared the fielder easily
Touch short and wide, cut hard. Cummins half-stops it to the right, technically a misfield
Dances down, punches it off a length to the left of the sliding cover fielder
Chops it late to pick up a quick single to short third. Porel a touch late on the run but the throw strikes him on the way

Pummelled to the left of the sliding long-on fielder. Abhishek delivered it off the front of the hand, a bit like a carrom ball, but it was shortish and sat up. Porel danced down and pulled it hard into the ground
Full on fourth, driven to long-off
Dances down, reaches across to get close to the pitch of the wide, length ball. Drives it through cover, along the ground
Full on middle, Stubbs stays leg side of the ball and tries to punch it back. It goes off the inner-half of the bat, to long-on
Loopy full ball on middle is delivered from wide of the crease. Whisked to long-on
Hit to deep square leg to keep strike
Length on off, punched to long-off
Fullish on middle, flicked to long-on
Length ball just outside leg stump, 88ks, flicked off the back foot to deep midwicket

Bowled round the legs. Zeeshan reduces Rahul's explosion into a cameo. Has three-for too. Was a pre-meditated shot, Rahul went across to off stump and got on one knee for a powerful sweep. He missed it, the ball was very close to the pad but went uninterrupted to flatten leg stump. Replays show it may have grazed pad. Was a legbreak that landed around leg stump, hawk-eye says the ball would've gone well down leg had it not spun.
Googly at 88ks on a fullish length, lands around off and straightens a touch. Leading edge off the gentle flick goes to long-off
Pitched up again, worked to long-on
Death option from Shami. Pace-on yorker at middle and leg, jammed to midwicket
Whoa, he really is letting himself loose. Opens up extra cover with an inside-out drive. The follow-through was powerful and stopped around head-height for the photographers.
This is a new Rahul, he set up last ball, does the same this time, got a slower ball in the slot and mowed it 90 metres over midwicket. It's a slog sweep that's almost hit square-on
Rahul opens up his stance, front leg out the way, and Shami bumps him. At the stumps, but too high. Let go
French cut to get off the mark. Rahul tried to drive the length ball on fourth through mid-off, got a thick inside edge that went wide of leg stump and very fine
Hard length, angling in towards fourth, guided softly towards short third for a quick single

Soft, soft dismissal and Fraser-McGurk is out of here! Lands it on a length on middle, JFM looks to just push it down the ground. All he does it chip it back tamely to Zeeshan, 15 runs and two wickets in the over. Is there still life in the game?
That's more like it! The JFM we all know. Lands it on a length outside off, he stands tall, gets under it and deposits it over long-off
Much better. Goes back to the legspinning length ball and opens the face of the bat. Bisects backward point and cover-point, and there is no protection in the deep
Sneaks through his legs via the inside edge! Full and quick on leg, he looks to go big over the off side but gets lucky as he beats short fine leg
Fuller on middle, knocked down to long-on to get going

Fantastic catch from Mulder, Zeeshan provides the breakthrough. Tossed up on middle, du Plessis looks to go big but skies it high. Mulder has his eyes on the ball as he runs in from long-on, has to dive forward to clinch it and does so while he tumbles. du Plessis falls after a superb knock, surely DC can't mess it up from here
Superb effort from Reddy at deep backward point. Short and wide outside off, he cuts it past backward point. Heads to the ropes, if not for a diving effort from NKR
Goes wide of the crease and digs it in, du Plessis ducks under it. Klaasen takes hsi eyes off and concedes a few byes
Length ball outside off, punched to cover
Short and angling in, directed with a cross blade to deep square leg. Brings up a fantastic half-century off just 26 balls
Full and outside off, driven to deep cover
Very full outside off, dug out in front of square on the off side
The googly on a length outside off, he goes for the cut but misses
Just wide of extra cover. Is it the shot that gets Fraser-McGurk going? Floated up on a length outside off, he stands tall and smashes it aerially just past the man in the ring
Flatter outside off, slashed to backward point
Floated full outside off, drilled to long-off
Another short one outside off, he pulls it over midwicket. NKR gets around and fires a flat throw to the bowler's end, where Fraser-McGurk has to dive to get back in
Half-tracker outside off to begin, slashed through covers
Yorker on off, squeezed through forward square leg. It's not gone a fair distance and before Aniket can come charging in from deep midwicket, they pinch two
Low full toss on middle, driven down to long-on
Short and just wide outside off, he goes for the pull but withdraws from the shot
Full toss on middle, flicked to deep midwicket
Cummins goes off pace, du Plessis is on song! It is right in the slot outside off, he has his base set up and tonks it straight over the bowler
Cut fiercely, backward point a mere spectator! Short and wide outside off, du Plessis hangs back and slashes it hard
Length ball outside off, slashes it to cover, JFM struggling to get the ball away from the square. That ends the powerplay, could be respite for him
Goes wide on the crase again and spears it in on leg, he misses the heave-ho completely
Length ball outside off, punched to point
Bowls another length ball from wide of the crease, he can only heave it away to deep midwicket
Short and just outside off, he pulls it forward of square through the on side
Goes wide on the crease and bowls an off-pace ball on a length, du Plessis does not pick it up and is early into his hack. It was just 122kph
Bangs it short and wide outside off, easy leave as it passes way over
Goes back to the length ball to punch it through cover, eventful over

Straight up and Cummins drops this now. Again, not an easy chance as he runs back to his left from mid-on. He had long-off rushing forward in his peripheral vision. Only gets his fingertips. Fraser-McGurk went for the slog across the line and only hit it high up in the air but got away
Slows it down outside off, he looks to go hard over the off side but misses
Quicker and fuller outside off, he makes room and drills it to cover, where NKR dives and stops, not enough to prevent the single though
Goneskiiii! A hit-me ball, du Plessis obliges. Short on the stumps, he goes back and pulls it over long-on
Ouch, that must have hurt! Full on middle, he slams it straight back at Fraser-McGurk

Reddy does the hard work but then lets it through. He covers good ground to his left from deep midwicket, puts in the slide and it goes through. JFM had nailed the pull off the short ball and Cummins almost got away with it. 13 off the over

Dropped but a brilliant effort! Fraser-McGurk backs away and looks to loft the length ball over mid-off. A miscue keeps Aniket in play. He runs back, has his eyes on the ball and throws his right hand as he leaps but fails to cling on
Offcutter n a length outside off, he misses the flash, it was just 112kph
Goes for the yorker on off and middle, whipped through midwicket
Full and angling in, flicked through midwicket
Clears mid-off with ease! Full and just outside off, du Plessis hangs back and lofts it over the off side
Moves across to off and heaves the length ball, 140.6kph, to Kishan at short midwicket. Two dots to end the over but 15 off it
Shortish on off, he gets behind and defends it back
Length ball on middle, 139.9kph, mistimed through mid-on
Strays on the pad, pays the price. Swings in on a fuller length, du Plessis looks to flick it away and it brushes his pad and runs away
Width given, du Plessis puts it away. A bit of swing outside off, he stays leg side and thrashes it over backward point
Picked up with absolute ease! It is as if du Plessis knew what was coming. He stood still to the back of a length ball at 139.4kph, lofts it over the shorter side, the deep square leg boundary
Floated full outside leg, he flicked to deep midwicket, not a bad over from Abhishek
Flatter outside off, cut to point
Quicker and fuller on leg, he goes back to punch it to long-off
Humongous blow! Tossed up in his slot outside off, he clears the front leg, gets down on a knee and slogs it high over long-off
Very full on leg, clipped to backward square leg
Full on off, driven down to long-off
Hangs back to the length ball outside off, 138kph, pats it towards backward point for a quick run, quiet start to the chase
Length ball nipping in from a back of a length, he steers it wide of backward point to get off the mark
Swings and misses! Length ball that swings away, Fraser-McGurk goes hard and makes contact with only thin air
Outside off on a length, 137.5kph, he gets a bottom edge to the off side on the slash
Swinging away from a shortish length outside off, he slashes it to cover, 137.4kph
Length ball outside off, 136.8kph, a hint of shape away, defended towards cover from the crease
